resources.name: Favored Terrains
resources.description: One favored terrain at 2nd level and another at 6th level and every 4 levels thereafter. Record the selected terrains and distributed bonuses.

resources.name: Ranger Traps
resources.description: Daily uses of each learned extraordinary ranger trap equal Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). A gun-training selection may be exchanged for one learned trap.

resources.name: Bombs
resources.description: At 5th level, bombs per day equal effective Alchemist level (Gunslinger level - 4) + Charisma modifier, minimum 1. Bomb dice use that same effective Alchemist level and always include Explosive Bombs.

resources.name: Armor Training Rank
resources.description: Reduce armor check penalty and increase maximum Dexterity by 1 at 4th level and every 4 levels thereafter, to a maximum of 4. If another class grants Armor Training, use the better result rather than stacking.

entries.choice_handling_note: Trade and martial traditions use the shared tradition pickers. The competent trade rank and alternating utility/combat-or-skill talent budget are derived from the reviewed profile.
Casting ability and casting tradition are selected through the shared Spheres casting workflow; the spell pool replaces grit and pays both deeds and amplified sphere effects.
Elemental Focus and both Expanded Element selections are fixed to Fire. The mount is fixed to a horse or pony and uses effective Druid level equal to Kineticist level - 3.

choice_providers.label: Destructive Focus
choice_providers.description: Choose the primary Destruction blast group and associated kinetic element. It grants that element's basic utility talent and one matching blast-type talent.

resources.name: Daily Pathfinder Focus
resources.description: Choose Scrolls, Spells, or Swords when preparing spells. The exact mystery, spirits, weapons, and later benefits may be changed at the next preparation.

resources.name: Versatile Hex
resources.description: Record one temporary Shaman or spirit hex at 6th level, increasing to two at 14th level. Choices last until the next spell preparation.

entries.choice_handling_note: Spirit Surge changes the delivery method of one qualifying spell at cast time; it is neither a spirit-influence pool nor a persistent build choice.

power_providers.label: Revelations of the Past
power_providers.description: Choose an Ancestor or Time mystery revelation at 4th, 6th, 12th, 14th, and 20th levels. Shaman level replaces Oracle level and Wisdom replaces Charisma.

resources.name: Wandering Ritual
resources.description: One daily one-hour spirit bond at 6th level, two at 8th, and three at 14th. The bond grants spirit ability and spirit magic; greater spirit power unlocks at 12th and true spirit power at 20th.
